title: Recover federation workers after cooperative credential-read cancellation
outcome: A configuration stop during a side-effect-free credential read does not permanently quarantine the peer after the owned operation completes; unresolved SSH ownership remains fenced.
acceptance: Reconfiguration during a held credential read permits a successor after the read settles, without host restart or duplicate unresolved OS operations.
Cancellation and timeout are distinguished while preserving late-child exact cleanup; regressions prove re-enable recovery and genuine cleanup uncertainty remains quarantined.
